Equal information: we know who is out tonight, nothing more. We predict final margin at 13.035 RMSE, the closing spread 12.856.

The market is ahead by 0.179 points of RMSE and wins 12 of 13 seasons. We are not redundant even so: added to the close our number lowers out-of-sample error (12.933 → 12.908), 95% interval excluding zero.

Not a betting product. This is a baseline — nothing here is priced against the vig, and no profitability is claimed.

Caveats
  • “Who is out” is read off the box score rather than a pre-game inactives list, which if anything over-informs us — the bias runs our way and the close still leads.
  • In-play feeds are excluded, because their “spread” already knows part of the score: Caesars (New Jersey) - Live Odds, Caesars Sportsbook (New Jersey) - Live Odds, DraftKings - Live Odds, ESPN Bet - Live Odds.
  • Before 2024 a book posts one line rather than an explicit close; on the 3,155 games carrying both they agree 99.3% of the time.
  • Scoring environments move season to season, which is why the chart plots the gap rather than raw RMSE — both sides share that season's denominator, so the gap is the quantity that compares.
  • Every figure is rebuilt from the 13,068 game-level residuals at publish time; nothing is typed by hand.
